page_topic_one_liner: AI glossary reference — 140+ terms covering ML, LLMs, vision, generative AI, and AI tools
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a single-domain AI term index / dictionary page, NOT the three-pillar glossary hub, NOT a single term definition, NOT SEO strategy or LLM chat. Hero must be an A–Z glossary index dense with AI-specific term rows and chip cloud — NOT generic book icon or chat panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): AI glossary index mockup — vertical A–Z alphabet sidebar (letter pills), main column with 6–8 stacked term rows (blurred AI term titles like LLM, transformer, embedding + one-line definition blur), one row accent-highlighted
Secondary: dictionary page spread vignette — open reference spread with highlighted AI term block and definition blur lines
Tertiary: floating term chip cloud (8–10 blurred AI-domain chips: neural network, diffusion, RAG, fine-tuning, token, prompt, etc.) clustered beside index
anti_patterns: Three-pillar hub cards (SEO/Marketing/AI) — this is AI-only glossary
Single term definition hero (one word + long paragraph)
LLM chat panel as hero (this is reference index not GEO)
Knowledge-graph hub-spoke or traffic curve (that is SEO strategy guide)
Empty term rows or blank placeholder chips
OpenAI/Anthropic/Google logos or real model names as readable text
